'''Lazeria City Starport''', also called LCS, was the largest point of entry on the planet and the only one that was designed to handle passenger traffic. Located in [[Lazeria City]], it also housed a heavily armed and staffed section of [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|Imperial Customs]] and twelve Imperial-manned [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]]. The starport was home to the [[Lazerian Orbital Command]].
